reels.caption:
Did you know that the Kölner Dom took 632 years to complete? Construction began in 1248 and was finally finished in 1880, making it one of the longest building projects in architectural history. Towering above #Cologne with its iconic twin Gothic spires, the #cathedral was designed to house the relics of the Three Kings. Surviving wars and centuries of change, Kölner Dom still stands as a remarkable symbol of faith, craftsmanship, and perseverance. #architectanddesign

• #architecture #germany
